gallery.title: File:CowansBatteryAdvancesBeforeBattleofWilliamsburg1862.jpg
gallery.description: Cowan's Battery advances across the Warwick River on May 4, 1862 before they engage in the Battle of Williamsburg. The Confederate fieldworks that lay before them is the site where the 1st Vermont Brigade was repelled on April 16 during the Battle of Yorktown.
categories: American Civil War photographs of artillery
